hold_text: Executor fix on the live prop executor (src/prop/prop_executor.py run_cycle). A single failed journal read (api.open_fills) wrote the permanent AUTO-REVERT latch. On 2026-09-30 an ict-web-api restart by the deploy (16:05:05-07Z) refused one read at 16:05:06Z and halted breakout_1 until a person cleared it (#14808). Now a failed journal read counts toward TRIP_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS like a terminal read, and blocks entries that cycle only, returning before intake so no ticket is refused. Held: the manager reviews and merges.
why: Every runtime-touching merge restarts ict-web-api for about 2-4 s; one unlucky tick must not disable the executor. PI-20260930-KMYJ5XC7-0011.
